answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The onyx cap is checked at intake and haven shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a opal tag. That is 13 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
